SILLAGE / DATA CREDITS

A note on the library.

The original 38 hand-written profiles come from the Sillage repository. Additional selected profiles are derived from the Scento Perfume Database, © Scento, licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International, via the repository’s imported dataset.

Fields and names are mapped into Sillage’s model. Occasion, weather and performance guidance may be estimated and is identified as such in the scent profiles. Scento does not endorse this explorer. Hand-curated additions link their product sources from the scent profile. Unknown data is left unspecified.

The collection starts empty. Ownership comes only from bottles you add on this browser. A catalogue profile alone never establishes ownership. Body sprays, aftershave, unresolved variants and entries without a matched scent profile are excluded from owned-fragrance recommendations.

Wearing guidance is a subjective, scent-specific editorial mapping. A fragrance can fit multiple occasions. Unknown notes are left unspecified.

Current city weather and geocoding are provided by Open-Meteo using CC BY 4.0 data. The initial city is London and can be changed. Manual scenarios remain available if weather cannot be fetched. Plans and city preferences are saved on the browser.

Product photographs are credited to their brands or retailers in each profile. Images identify products; bottle size and packaging can vary.
